newsitem.title: USA: TJX sets $250 mln of stock repurchases.
newsitem.headline: TJX sets $250 mln of stock repurchases.

text.p: TJX Cos Inc said Wednesday its board has authorized the repurchase of up to $250 million of TJX Stock.

At current prices, this would represent about 6 percent of the company's outstanding common shares, it said. The program provides for the repurchase of TJX common and series E preferred stock and will be accomplished through open market purchases or through other transactions.
Chief Executive Officer Bernard Cammarata said, "This share buyback program represents our continued commitment to enhance shareholder value.
"Given TJX's strong cash position and excellent capital structure, the company believes this program is warranted.
"Our operations continue to provide exciting growth and generate strong cash flow, which enables TJX to look to the future with great financial flexibility."

TJX is the largest off-price apparel retailer, with 583 T.J. Maxx stores, 457 Marshalls stores, 68 Winners Apparel Ltd off-price family apparel stores in Canada, 21 HomeGoods off-price home fashions stores and 20 T.K. Maxx off-price apparel stores in the United Kingdom.
